Watch Confession on The Daily Wire.

Set in 1938 Moscow under Stalin’s brutal dictatorship, Confession follows Alexei, a former priest who is arrested and taken to the notorious Lubyanka Prison. There, he comes face-to-face with Vladimir, a former student who has become an interrogator for the very regime they once stood against.

As their interrogation unfolds, old relationships, buried secrets, and conflicting loyalties begin to surface. Trapped between his faith and the demands of a ruthless political system, Alexei must confront his past and find a way to survive a confrontation that could cost him everything.

Starring James Franco, Rob Lowe, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Kodi Smit-McPhee, Nick Nolte, and Emile Hirsch.
